title: MODIFICATION OF PARKING REQUIREMENTS IN THE RESIDENTIAL BUFFER SUBDISTRICT
previewText: In the Residential Buffer Subdistrict, parking shall be provided at the rate of one space per 300 square feet of floor area for grocery and convenience retailers and specialty food retailers listed under Use Group VI. Cellar space used for retailing shall be included for the purpose of calculating requirements for accessory off-street parking spaces and accessory off-street loading berths.
